practices.title: Practice 1: ➕ Addition Quests (3-Digit Word Problems)
practices.description: Practice 3-digit addition word problems with clue words like 'more', 'altogether', 'in all', and 'combined'!
practices.hint: Line up ones, tens, and hundreds. When ones or tens reach 10, carry 1 over!

practices.title: Practice 2: ➖ Subtraction Quests (3-Digit Word Problems)
practices.description: Practice 3-digit subtraction word problems with clue words like 'left', 'are gone', 'float away', and 'difference'!
practices.hint: If the top number in a column is smaller, borrow 1 from the column to the left!

practices.title: Practice 3: 🔄 Mixed Adventure Clues (Add or Subtract?)
practices.description: Detect whether the adventure story is asking you to ADD (+) or SUBTRACT (-), then solve the problem accurately!
practices.hint: Check the question: are we combining groups (+), or finding what is left after some leave (-)?

quiz.title: Revision Final Quiz: Grand Adventure Math Quest
quiz.description: A fun 10-question Math Adventure quiz mixing Island Pirates, Cosmic Space, Castle Carnival, and Safari Rescue word problems!
quiz.hint: Read the story carefully, check if you need to add or subtract, and calculate step-by-step!
quiz.instruction: Read the math adventure story and tap the best answer!

questions.instruction: Think about the gold coins on the pirate island.
questions.text: Mia and Leo found 248 gold coins on the beach. Then they found 135 more coins inside a cave. How many coins do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Add ones first: 8 + 5 = 13. Write 3, carry 1 to tens!

questions.instruction: Remember the monkey's banana snack.
questions.text: The playful monkey had 126 bananas in his tree. Then he gathered 238 more bananas. How many bananas does he have now?
questions.hint: Add ones: 6 + 8 = 14. Write 4, carry 1 ten to the tens place!

questions.instruction: Count the star crystals on the space voyage.
questions.text: Astronaut Mia collected 314 star crystals. Then Leo found 178 more crystals. How many star crystals do they have in all?
questions.hint: Add ones: 4 + 8 = 12. Write 2, carry 1 to tens: 1 + 1 + 7 = 9 tens!

questions.instruction: Help the friendly space alien count berries.
questions.text: The alien had 237 cosmic berries in his basket. He picked 245 more berries from the glow-tree. How many berries does he have in all?

questions.instruction: Count the wizard's magic potions.
questions.text: The castle wizard brewed 265 blue bubble potions and 158 green sparkle potions. How many potions did he brew altogether?
questions.hint: Double regrouping: ones make 13 (carry 1), then tens make 12 (carry 1)!

questions.instruction: Count the bakery's rainbow cupcakes.
questions.text: The castle baker frosted 184 fairy cupcakes in the morning and 239 more in the afternoon. How many cupcakes were frosted in all?

questions.instruction: Count the zebras at the savanna waterhole.
questions.text: Rangers observed 248 zebras drinking at the waterhole. Then 165 more zebras arrived. How many zebras are there altogether?

questions.instruction: Count the apples for the hungry elephant.
questions.text: An elephant ate 158 red apples for breakfast and 267 green apples for lunch. How many apples did the elephant eat in all?

questions.instruction: Count the coconuts on the pirate island.
questions.text: The pirate ship cook gathered 315 brown coconuts and 242 green coconuts. How many coconuts did he gather in all?
questions.hint: No regrouping needed here! Add straight down: 5+2=7, 1+4=5, 3+2=5.

questions.instruction: Count the colorful sea shells.
questions.text: Leo collected 234 shiny seashells. Mia brought 153 more seashells. How many seashells do they have altogether?
questions.hint: Add ones: 4 + 3 = 7. Add tens: 3 + 5 = 8. Add hundreds: 2 + 1 = 3.

questions.instruction: Add cosmic space energy cells.
questions.text: The space station has 346 solar energy cells in Sector A and 281 cells in Sector B. How many energy cells are there in total?
questions.hint: Add ones: 6 + 1 = 7. Add tens: 4 + 8 = 12 (write 2, carry 1 hundred)!

questions.instruction: Count knights and guards at the castle gate.
questions.text: There are 215 royal knights and 178 castle guards on parade. How many protectors are there altogether?

questions.instruction: Count safari baby gazelles.
questions.text: A safari wildlife herd has 254 adult gazelles and 168 baby gazelles. How many gazelles are in the herd in all?

questions.instruction: Count balloons at the carnival entrance.
questions.text: The carnival booth set up 328 blue balloons and 195 yellow balloons. How many balloons are set up altogether?

questions.instruction: Count silver coins in the treasure chest.
questions.text: Mia put 416 silver coins in the chest. Leo added 259 more silver coins. How many silver coins are in the chest now?

questions.instruction: Remember the purple crystals in the cave.
questions.text: There were 376 sparkling crystals in the cave. 142 crystals are gone. How many crystals are left?

questions.instruction: Remember the balloons floating away over the bridge.
questions.text: There were 524 balloons tied to the bridge railing. 217 balloons floated away into the sky. How many balloons are left?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 14 - 7 = 7. Tens: 1 - 1 = 0. Hundreds: 5 - 2 = 3.

questions.instruction: Subtract moon crater rocks tested in the lab.
questions.text: The space rover had 486 moon rocks. Scientists tested 251 rocks under the microscope. How many moon rocks are left?

questions.instruction: Calculate remaining spaceship shield power.
questions.text: The rocket had 635 shield units. Flying through cosmic dust used up 318 units. How many shield units remain?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 15 - 8 = 7. Tens: 2 - 1 = 1. Hundreds: 6 - 3 = 3.

questions.instruction: Count carnival ride tickets left in the box.
questions.text: The ticket booth started with 578 tickets. Eager visitors bought 243 tickets. How many tickets are left?

questions.instruction: Count remaining celebration fireworks.
questions.text: The castle had 642 fireworks. 219 fireworks launched into the night sky. How many fireworks are left in the castle?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 12 - 9 = 3. Tens: 3 - 1 = 2. Hundreds: 6 - 2 = 4.

questions.instruction: Count baby turtles resting on the beach.
questions.text: There were 467 baby sea turtles on the shore. 235 scrambled into the ocean waves. How many turtles are still on the beach?

questions.instruction: Count flamingos still wading in the lake.
questions.text: There were 625 pink flamingos in the lake. 218 flamingos flew away to find food. How many flamingos stayed in the lake?

questions.instruction: Subtract coconuts eaten by island parrots.
questions.text: The pirate island grove had 548 ripe coconuts. Hungry parrots ate 226 coconuts. How many coconuts are left on the trees?

questions.instruction: Subtract space astronaut oxygen tanks.
questions.text: The spaceship carried 756 oxygen tanks. The crew used 324 tanks during spacewalks. How many oxygen tanks are left?

questions.instruction: Subtract carnival prizes given away.
questions.text: The ring toss booth started with 482 teddy bears. Lucky children won 167 bears. How many teddy bears remain at the booth?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 12 - 7 = 5. Tens: 7 - 6 = 1. Hundreds: 4 - 1 = 3.

questions.instruction: Count safari water canteen bottles.
questions.text: The safari ranger base had 650 water canteens. Rangers took 235 canteens on patrol. How many canteens are left at base?
questions.hint: In ones: 0 - 5 needs borrowing! Borrow 1 ten: 10 - 5 = 5. Tens: 4 - 3 = 1. Hundreds: 6 - 2 = 4.

questions.instruction: Subtract pirate gold coins spent on supplies.
questions.text: Captain Mia had 875 gold coins. She spent 348 coins to repair the pirate ship. How many coins does she have left?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 15 - 8 = 7. Tens: 6 - 4 = 2. Hundreds: 8 - 3 = 5.

questions.instruction: Subtract flowers planted in the royal garden.
questions.text: The gardener had 734 flower seeds. He planted 218 seeds in the courtyard. How many seeds are left in his pouch?

questions.instruction: Count safari birds resting in the trees.
questions.text: There were 583 weaver birds in the acacia trees. 256 birds flew to the river. How many birds stayed in the trees?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 13 - 6 = 7. Tens: 7 - 5 = 2. Hundreds: 5 - 2 = 3.

questions.instruction: Decide: do you add or subtract?
questions.text: Mia found 320 gold coins. Leo found 145 more coins. Which operation should you use to find how many coins they have altogether?
questions.hint: The clue words 'more' and 'altogether' mean you should ADD (+).
questions.explanation: Because they found MORE coins and we want the total ALTOGETHER, we add: 320 + 145 = 465 coins!

questions.instruction: Decide: do you add or subtract?
questions.text: There were 450 balloons on the bridge. 130 balloons popped and were gone. Which operation finds how many balloons are left?
questions.hint: The clue words 'popped' and 'left' mean you should SUBTRACT (-).
questions.explanation: Because balloons popped and went away, we subtract: 450 - 130 = 320 balloons left!

questions.instruction: Solve this island math mystery.
questions.text: A pirate ship has 412 wooden planks on deck. The carpenter nailed on 179 more planks. How many planks are there in all?
questions.hint: Add ones: 2 + 9 = 11 (write 1, carry 1 ten). Tens: 1 + 1 + 7 = 9. Hundreds: 4 + 1 = 5.

questions.instruction: Solve this cosmic space mystery.
questions.text: The moon station had 745 food packs. The astronauts ate 218 packs. How many food packs are left for the rest of the mission?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 15 - 8 = 7. Tens: 3 - 1 = 2. Hundreds: 7 - 2 = 5.

questions.instruction: Solve this castle carnival mystery.
questions.text: Dragon Barnaby collected 246 silver coins. Then the King gave him 185 more silver coins. How many silver coins does Barnaby have in all?

questions.instruction: Solve this safari ranger mystery.
questions.text: A safari watering hole had 684 liters of fresh water. Wild elephants drank 238 liters. How many liters of water are left?

questions.instruction: Compare two groups of pirate treasures.
questions.text: Mia's treasure chest has 356 gems. Leo's chest has 234 gems. What is the difference between their gem counts?

questions.instruction: Find the combined total of space stars.
questions.text: Telescope A discovered 268 new stars. Telescope B discovered 175 new stars. What is the combined total of discovered stars?

questions.instruction: Count castle banners after a windy storm.
questions.text: The castle walls were decorated with 560 colorful banners. A gust of wind blew down 135 banners. How many banners are still hanging?
questions.hint: Borrow 1 ten for ones: 10 - 5 = 5. Tens: 5 - 3 = 2. Hundreds: 5 - 1 = 4.

questions.instruction: Count safari animals spotted on morning drive.
questions.text: Tourists saw 148 wild animals in the north valley and 236 wild animals in the south meadow. How many animals did they see in all?

questions.instruction: Solve this pirate map distance puzzle.
questions.text: The pirate map measures 860 steps from the bay to Skull Rock. Mia walked 345 steps. How many steps does she have left to walk?

questions.instruction: Solve this cosmic satellite puzzle.
questions.text: A communication satellite sent 359 signals on Monday and 264 signals on Tuesday. How many signals were sent altogether?

questions.instruction: Count carnival candy apples.
questions.text: The candy booth made 425 shiny red candy apples. Happy families bought 182 apples. How many candy apples remain?
questions.hint: Ones: 5 - 2 = 3. Tens: 2 - 8 needs borrowing! Borrow 1 hundred: 12 - 8 = 4. Hundreds: 3 - 1 = 2.

questions.instruction: Count safari trees planted for elephants.
questions.text: Rangers planted 176 shady acacia trees last month and 258 trees this month. How many trees were planted in all?

questions.instruction: Solve the final treasure chest riddle.
questions.text: The legendary golden chest holds 750 shiny jewels in all. 325 jewels are sparkling diamonds. How many jewels are colorful rubies?
